issues.legal_issue: The statutory definition of a Deputy Commissioner determines whether an Assistant Commissioner in charge of a subdivision may exercise land-acquisition functions without separate appointment.
material_facts: Land-acquisition proceedings were initiated by an Assistant Commissioner in charge of a subdivision.
The High Court quashed the proceedings, holding that the Assistant Commissioner needed a special notification to perform a Deputy Commissioner's functions.
The State appealed the High Court's decision.
issues.conclusion: An Assistant Commissioner in charge of a subdivision is included within the definition of Deputy Commissioner and does not require separate empowerment to perform those functions; the High Court's order was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 3(c) of the Mysore Land Acquisition Act, an Assistant Commissioner in charge of a subdivision is expressly included in the meaning of Deputy Commissioner. Separate appointment by the Government is required for other officers, not for such an Assistant Commissioner. The judgment relies on no earlier cases.

predicates.land_acquisition_proceeding: The proceeding concerns the acquisition of land.
predicates.assistant_commissioner_in_charge_of_subd: An Assistant Commissioner is in charge of a subdivision.

issues.definition: When a land-acquisition proceeding involves an Assistant Commissioner in charge of a subdivision, that officer may exercise Deputy Commissioner functions without separate appointment.
